body:
The harbor buoy rings through the water like a ghostly dance, its surface reflecting the distant sky in shimmering waves. I can hear the faint rippling sounds from beneath the surface, each one a whisper of danger lurking just beyond sight. My heart pounds in my chest as panic starts to creep up, threatening to overwhelm me. 

I take a deep breath, steadying myself on the rough deck of the small boat. "It's okay," I mutter to myself, trying to reassure my trembling mind. But the sound of the buoy keeps echoing back, taunting me further.
